name: Financial Report Analysis
desc: Turning complex financial documents into structured, actionable information.
details: Financial Report Analysis turns dense annual reports and financial statements into structured information that is easier to inspect, compare, and use in downstream analysis.

It breaks key figures into clear charts and calculates an M-score index alongside financial highlights, helping teams spot trends and assess potential reporting risks without working through every page manually.
